title: Explicit canonical contraction of the last affine line
statement: Let P, A, Y, aY, C_j, T_j and H_j be the finite purity setting, separated finite-type base, ordered compact support, Tate powers and external source of [def-pur-affine-space-binary-trace-coordinates] and [def-pur-ordered-affine-trace-data]. For d>=0 put m=d+1. Define e:T_(m+1) ≅ F_(q_m)(T_m) by the inverse of the canonical coefficient-unit identification tateSourceIso:F_j(A_Y)≅T_j of the ordered trace data [def-pur-ordered-affine-trace-data] at j=m+1, then sourceReassociation of [def-pur-affine-space-comparison], then lineSource [def-pur-affine-space-comparison] applied to tateSourceIso at j=m. For a supplied etale-origin proof h on H_m and invertibility hq of the specified coefficient-first line projection [def-pur-affine-line-purity-comparison], define L_m:C_(m+1)T_(m+1)→C_mT_m as C_(m+1)(e), inverse canonical compact-support composition, C_m of canonical origin change from the standing q_m compactification to its standard projective-line compactification, then C_m of projectionTensorTrace at T_m and the normalized trace. Origin membership is transported by externalTateIso followed by e. h and hq are proofs only. This definition chooses neither a trace nor an arbitrary map. The normalized trace and originChange are the explicitly defined operations in [def-pur-normalized-line-evaluation-trace] and [def-pur-trace-origin-compactification-change]; no theorem conclusion from those nodes is used to construct L_m. The projection source, inverse projection and module right unitor are the constructions of [def-pur-affine-line-purity-coordinate-maps].

def lastLineContraction (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY] [IsSeparated aY] (d : ℕ)
    (h : DerivedCategory.plusEtaleOrigin (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Ring P))
      (iteratedAffineLine Y (d + 2)) (externalTate P Y (d + 1)))
    (hq : ProjectionInvertible (Ring P)
      (affineTraceLineCompactification (iteratedAffineLine Y (d + 1)))
      (coefficient P.coefficients.l P.extension (P.level - 1)
        (iteratedAffineLine Y (d + 1)) P.level (annihilates P)) (tate P Y (d + 1))) :
    (compact P Y (d + 2)).obj (tate P Y (d + 2)) ⟶
      (compact P Y (d + 1)).obj (tate P Y (d + 1))
